list.title: e-Documents
list.lead: e-Fatura and e-Arşiv documents issued for invoices. Problem documents wait for staff.

panel.title: e-Fatura / e-Arşiv
panel.none: No e-document for this invoice yet.
panel.disabled: e-Invoicing is off. Turn it on under Settings → e-Invoice.
panel.cancel_confirm: The e-Arşiv invoice will be cancelled through the integrator and reported to the tax authority. This cannot be undone. Continue?

settings.lead: Issues invoices as e-Fatura or e-Arşiv invoices through a private integrator. Buyers registered for e-Fatura get an e-Fatura, everyone else an e-Arşiv invoice. Enter the connection details under Integrations.
settings.section_general_lead: When documents are issued and through which integrator.
settings.enabled_hint: While on, VKN / TCKN validation is also enforced for clients in Türkiye.
settings.issue_on_hint: When the payment arrives (recommended) or when the invoice is issued.
settings.start_date_hint: YYYY-MM-DD. Invoices issued before this date get no e-document. Left empty, the day it is switched on is used.
settings.test_mode_hint: While on, documents are only sent through an integration connected to a test environment.
settings.section_numbering_lead: Document no.: series (3 characters) + year + 9-digit sequence (e.g. ABC2026000000001). Paraşüt assigns numbers itself.
settings.series_hint: 3 upper-case letters or digits; must match a series defined at the integrator.
settings.section_exemption_lead: Tax-authority exemption code for invoices with VAT-free lines.
settings.exemption_code_hint: E.g. 351 (non-exempt other) or 301 etc. Special base (8xx) and export-registered (7xx) codes are not supported.
settings.section_pdf_lead: The invoice PDF generated by HostingOS (not a substitute for the e-document).
settings.attach_pdf: Attach the PDF to invoice e-mails
settings.bank_details_hint: Shown at the bottom of the PDF (IBAN, bank name…).
settings.no_integration: No e-invoice integration yet. Add one under Integrations first.
settings.company_incomplete: Company details are incomplete: enter a valid VKN / TCKN, tax office and city under Settings → General.
settings.invalid_series: A series is 3 upper-case letters or digits.
settings.same_series: Use different series for e-Fatura and e-Arşiv.
settings.series_required: A series is required while e-invoicing is on.
settings.invalid_exemption: Enter a valid tax-authority VAT exemption code.
settings.unsupported_exemption: Special base (8xx) and export-registered (7xx) codes are not supported.
settings.reason_required: Enter a reason for the exemption code.

validation.tax_number: Enter a valid VKN (10 digits) or, for a sole proprietorship, a TCKN (11 digits).
validation.tax_office: The tax office is required for e-invoicing.
validation.national_id: The T.C. identity number is not valid.
